sq.q: How do you establish a JDBC connection to a MySQL database?

lq.q: You are developing a student information system in Java. The application should connect to a MySQL database named college , fetch all student records from the students table, and display them on the console. Use JDBC classes Connection and Statement and ensure that proper exception handling and resource closing are implemented. Write a complete Java program to: Load JDBC driver Load JDBC driver Establish a connection Establish a connection Use Statement to retrieve all students from students table Use Statement to retrieve all students from students table Print the name and department of each student Print the name and department of each student Close resources properly Close resources properly
answer: public class StudentInfoApp { public static void main(String[] args) { String url = "jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/college"; String user = "root"; String password = "admin";
Connection con = null; Statement stmt = null; ResultSet rs = null;
// Establish connection con = DriverManager.getConnection(url, user, password);
// Execute SELECT query rs = stmt.executeQuery("SELECT name, department FROM students");

// Process ResultSet while (rs.next()) { System.out.println("Name: " + rs.getString("name") + ", Department: " + rs.getString("department")); } } catch (Exception e) { e.printStackTrace(); } finally { // Close resources try { if (rs != null) rs.close(); } catch (Exception e) {} try { if (stmt != null) stmt.close(); } catch (Exception e) {} try { if (con != null) con.close(); } catch (Exception e) {} } } }
